_comment: Threshold requirements from the Minnesota 2026-2028 Self-Scoring Worksheet: the Instructions and Requirements (PDF pp.4-8) and the Round 1 minimum threshold (pp.9-10). The QAP's own eligibility chapters are not extracted; the QAP-side floor for the RD/Small Projects set-aside and the tie breakers are in MN_qap_2026_2028.json.

criteria.heading: Strategic priority
criteria.quote: All projects must meet at least one of the HTC statutory strategic priorities or a strategic
criteria.note: Bond-financed projects under Minnesota Statutes chapter 474A are the highest strategic priority and need no separate one.

criteria.heading: Minimum 80 points for 9% credits
criteria.quote: demonstrate the project is eligible for no fewer than 80 points, excluding projects funded
criteria.note: 31% of the computed ceiling of 258, but the ceiling is unreachable, so the effective share is higher. The RD/Small Projects set-aside is excluded here without a figure; the QAP gives it 30 (MN_qap_2026_2028.json).

criteria.heading: Minimum 40 points for 4% bond credits
criteria.quote: Requests for Minnesota Housing-administered 4% HTCs in association with tax-exempt volume

criteria.heading: Extended duration: 30 years and qualified contract waiver
criteria.quote: must maintain the low-income use for a minimum of 30 years or longer, if a longer duration is selected.

criteria.heading: Rental housing design and construction standards
criteria.quote: The project must meet the requirements in the Minnesota Housing Rental Housing

criteria.heading: Deeper rent targeting: 2% of units at the 30% MTSP rent
criteria.quote: restrict at least 2% of the total units, with a minimum number of one unit, to rents at or below
criteria.note: Units with project-based rental assistance count; 100% PBRA projects are exempt.

criteria.heading: Deeper rent targeting: 3% of units at the HAP payment standard
criteria.quote: restrict at least 3% of the total units, with a minimum number of one unit, to rents at or below
criteria.note: Exempt for 100% PBRA projects and projects on Tribal reservations, Dakota communities and trust lands.

criteria.heading: Round 1 statutory minimum threshold type
criteria.quote: all 9% HTC applications submitted statewide in HTC Round 1 must meet one of the following threshold types
criteria.note: One of: in the Metropolitan Area, 75% SRO/efficiency/one-bedroom units at 30% AMI rents, 75% family units of two-plus bedrooms, or substantial rehab in a targeted neighbourhood; outside it, a locally identified need; statewide, set-asides for people with specified disabilities, preservation of subsidised housing, or USDA Rural Development projects (Minnesota Statutes 462A.222 subd. 3(e)).
